外面的战争还在继续，但那种旷世大战所引起的大地剧烈震动却慢慢远去。
雷霆泰坦和太古蓝龙王显然在搏杀中远离了这一片地域。
姜尤从小湖泊中探出头来，观察周围战况。
因为两大王者刚从这里战斗过，虽然遍地狼藉，但也没有生灵过来。
水面倒映出来的一个与众不同的鹰人模样。
他的鸟喙已经脱落，取而代之的是一个和前世人类一般的精致好看的鼻子和嘴，脸上的灰黑绒毛也脱落了一些，呈现出一个精致的轮廓。
而头顶上，原本灰白的头发变得银灰相间，更显光泽。
最显眼的是他的眼睛，原本鹰人的竖眸消失不见，取而代之的是一双灿若星辰的紫眸。
除此之外，身上的羽毛也脱落不少，手爪和脚爪不像原先那般的鹰爪，而是开始有了肉感。
而背上的双翼，由原本的灰黑色，开始夹杂着一些白色的羽毛。
这些白色的羽毛都是新生长出的，看的出来还十分鲜嫩。

姜尤看着面板，发现自己的全属性提高了很多，浑身都是力量。
而他的等级虽然没有出现在面板上，但他却知道，他已经是进入超凡！
泰坦与龙之血给予了他进入超凡的机会，而他把握住了。
接下来，便是准备从这场战争中，安全回归。
他拿起青铜剑，超凡之力涌动，丝丝雷光在剑身上缭绕。
再次面对双头飞龙，他便能有正面一战之力。
他从小湖中走出，看着青石上初具智慧光芒的小龟，准备待战后，连龟带石一起带走。
来到岸边，他振翅一扬，刚要升空，便听到了天地之间，传来了一声无比凄惨的痛呼。
“阿里勒托斯，今日，你死定了！”
雷霆泰坦的声音如同垂天之雷，打在芸芸众生之上。
只听不远的森林中，高大的雷霆泰坦奋力扣住蓝色巨龙的头颅和脖颈，双手似有十亿伏特。
蓝色巨龙的整个头颅都被他撕了下来，鲜血淋淋，恐怖不已！
随着“轰隆”的一声，蓝色巨龙的无头身躯轰然倒塌，如同河流一般的血液流入森林之中。
胜利者的雷霆泰坦则高举蓝龙王的头颅，使得龙王阵营的生物们纷纷逃窜。
而整个瀚海森林，属于泰坦阵营的智慧种族们，都发出了欢呼之声。
而看到眼前这一幕的姜尤内心却犹如火山爆发一般！
“这一战，居然就是那场导火索之战！龙皇之子阿里勒托斯之死，让泰坦与巨龙爆发了蔓延整个世界的战争！”
“天地都被打得崩塌！万族损失惨重！”
“我得先找到我的族人们，此战之后，便要考虑，如同在这场大战中，保存族群了。”

> Chapter 7 Trigger (Page 1)
The war outside is still going on, but the violent shaking of the earth caused by the unprecedented war is slowly fading away.
The Thunder Titan and the Ancient Blue Dragon King obviously stayed away from this area during the fight.
Jiang You poked his head out of the small lake and observed the surrounding battle situation.
Because the two kings had just fought here, and although the place was in a mess, no living beings came over.
A distinctive hawk-man appearance reflected in the water.
His beak has fallen off, replaced by a delicate and beautiful nose and mouth like the humans in the previous life. Some of the gray and black fluff on his face has also fallen off, showing a delicate outline.
On the top of the head, the originally gray hair turned silver and gray, making it even more shiny.
The most eye-catching thing was his eyes. The original vertical eyes of the hawk disappeared and were replaced by a pair of purple eyes as bright as stars.
In addition, a lot of feathers on the body have also fallen off, and the claws on the hands and feet are not like the original eagle claws, but have begun to have a fleshy feel.
The wings on the back began to be mixed with some white feathers from the original gray-black color.
These white feathers are newly grown, and they are still very fresh and tender.

[Level]: Not unlocked (sealed, will be opened after the game is launched)
[Skills]: Throwing (Mastery), Spear Skill (Mastery), Thunder Power (Extraordinary)
[Skill Points]: Not unlocked (sealed, will be opened after the game is launched)
[Talent]: Champion's Will (You have super insight and reaction capabilities, and your combat awareness surpasses everything else.)
[Mission System]: Not unlocked (sealed, will be opened after the game is launched)
[Game start countdown]: 5 hours and 35 minutes.
Jiang You looked at the panel and found that all his attributes had improved a lot, and his whole body was full of strength.
Although his level did not appear on the panel, he knew that he had already entered the transcendent realm!
The blood of Titans and Dragons gave him the chance to transcend, and he took it.
The next step is to prepare for a safe return from this war.
He picked up the bronze sword, extraordinary power surged, and wisps of lightning shone around the sword.
Facing the two-headed flying dragon again, he would be able to fight head-on.
He walked out of the small lake and looked at the little turtle that was beginning to gain wisdom on the bluestone. He was ready to take the turtle and the stone away with him after the battle.
Arriving at the shore, he fluttered his wings, and just as he was about to take off, he heard an extremely miserable cry of pain coming from between heaven and earth.
"Ariletus, you are dead today!"
The Thunder Titan's voice is like thunder from the sky, hitting all living beings.
In the forest not far away, the tall Thunder Titan struggled to hold the blue dragon's head and neck, his hands seemed to have a billion volts.
The entire head of the blue dragon was torn off by him, and it was bloody and terrifying!
With a "rumbling" sound, the headless body of the blue dragon collapsed, and blood like a river flowed into the forest.
The victor's Thunder Titan raised the head of the Blue Dragon King, causing the creatures in the Dragon King's camp to flee.
And throughout the vast forest, the intelligent races belonging to the Titan camp cheered.
But when Jiang You saw this scene in front of him, his heart felt like a volcano erupting!
"This battle is actually the trigger battle! The death of Ariletos, son of the Dragon King, caused a war between Titans and dragons that spread throughout the world!"
"The heaven and earth were shattered! All races suffered heavy losses!"
"I have to find my tribe first. After this battle, I have to consider preserving the tribe just like in this war."
